relevance_note: Two-centre case series with per-patient supplementary tables: "17 patients from 6 families with heterozygous likely loss-of-function variants in TNFAIP3 (ACMG class 4–5) were finally included."
method_note: Built with a Python script in the scratch directory that parsed Supplementary File 1 (per-family rows with stacked values) and Supplementary File 3 (ANA, other autoantibodies, treatments) straight from the Markdown; the parsed cells were checked by hand against the tables. Column totals agree with Table 1 (oral aphthosis 15, recurrent fever 9, genital ulcers 8, GI 9, skin 2, arthritis/tenosynovitis 3, NPI 7, autoimmunity 8), and the treatment cells agree with the therapy counts in the text (TNF inhibitors 7, methotrexate 5, JAK inhibitors 3, etc.). Stacked cells: a value was assigned to a person only when the number of ' / ' values equalled the number of patients in the family row. Feature cells with fewer values (e.g. family 1 recurrent fever '+ / + / +' for 4 patients; family 6 oral aphthosis 4 values for 5 patients) were left 'not reported' for every member of that family. '+' was read as present (the legend does not define it). Empty cells and NA are 'not reported'. The '-' in Supplementary File 3 is not defined, so it is 'not reported'. Labels: the text's own labels were used where it names a patient (pt1-pt4, p7, p10, pt13, p14, pt15, Pt16, pt17), assuming text pN/ptN = table 'Pt' N (consistent with the NPI column). The rest are 'Supplementary File 1 #N' from the bare-number 'Pt' column. The asterisks (*parents, **grandparents) are footnote markers and were left out of labels. Ages: the 'Age at analysis' column was recorded as age at last evaluation (it could mean age at genetic analysis). Units are not printed in that table; years were assumed because Table 1 gives a median age at onset of 5 (3–6), Figure 2 is in '(y)' and the text uses '<5 years'. Sex is not given per patient (only 'Female sex 12 (71)'). Inheritance: unmarked members of families 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 were recorded as 'inherited unspecified parent'. The basis is that the family row lists a carrier marked as a parent, plus 'All but one variants were inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern'. Parents and grandparents are 'not reported'. The exon 7-9 deletion (family 4) is called de novo, but no parental test results are stated, so its inheritance is 'not reported' under D-24. Variant type: the authors say only 'truncating variants resulting in stop codon' for all variants, so no nonsense/frameshift class was assigned; the CNV is 'large deletion/CNV'. Elevated inflammatory markers: observed when CRP at diagnosis was at least 0.5 mg/dL, the threshold the paper defines as an increase. Lower values were not recorded as excluded (one measurement at diagnosis). GI disease was mapped to the checklist item 'gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation' because Table 1 lists only inflammatory GI manifestations (5+3+1 = all 9 GI patients). Neuropsychiatric symptoms (ADHD, anxiety, mood disorders, ODD, pica, depression) were not mapped to 'central nervous system involvement'. ANA 'Negative' was recorded as an excluded ANA positivity, but the checklist item 'autoantibodies (ANA/other)' stays 'not reported' because other antibodies are marked with an undefined '-'. The group statement 'none of the patients in our cohort fulfilled the classification criteria for SLE' excludes SLE for all 17. IS, CXCL9/10 and PGA values were not extracted as features. Previously published individuals with individual-level facts in the Discussion were included: the ref 31 patient (Duan et al; de novo TNFAIP3 frameshift; NPSLE), the ref 32 patient (T674P; progressive neuroinflammation; baricitinib) and the ref 36 proband (cutaneous disease). The ref 36 proband carries 'the same TNFAIP3 variant' as the family with five NPI patients; by the NPI column that is family 6, p.Arg183Ter. The paper does not print it there, so variant_original_string is 'not reported'. Cohorts cited only at group level (refs 4, 9, 10/22, 21, 25, 29, 37) got no rows. Family 1 (pt1-pt4) was previously described in ref 8; they are described first-hand here, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported'. Ref 20 is cited for the exon 7-9 deletion, but the paper does not say patient 9 was previously described. Possible inconsistencies: 'Six patients had clinical onset <5 years' versus 7 patients with onset <5 in Supplementary File 1 (6 of them have NPI, so the sentence may refer to NPI patients). The text calls all variants 'truncating variants resulting in stop codon', although one is an exon deletion. 'a patients with a T674P variant' was read as one person. Spans for patients come from the family row (Pt cell through the relevant cell), or from two pieces of the row when it is long.
